prompt.zh: 如果明天可以少一件生活小麻煩，你會選哪個？
prompt.en: If tomorrow could remove one small everyday hassle, which would you choose?

prompt.zh: 今晚只能留下一種娛樂，你選哪個？
prompt.en: You can keep only one kind of entertainment tonight.

prompt.zh: 你可以讓一件家事永遠自動完成。
prompt.en: You can make one chore finish itself forever.

prompt.zh: 這個週末，你只能選一種恢復方式。
prompt.en: This weekend, you get only one way to recover.

prompt.zh: 朋友突然約你出門，哪個比較有吸引力？
prompt.en: A friend suddenly asks you to go out. What sounds better?

prompt.zh: 半夜肚子餓，只能選一個。
prompt.en: It is midnight and you are hungry. Pick one.

prompt.zh: 你可以消除一個日常壓力。
prompt.en: You can erase one everyday pressure.

prompt.zh: 今天只剩一點點力氣，你會拿去做哪件事？
prompt.en: You only have a tiny bit of energy left today. What gets it?

prompt.zh: 如果手機今晚會公開一個秘密，你比較不想被公開哪個？
prompt.en: If your phone exposed one secret tonight, which would you least want revealed?

prompt.zh: 朋友群只能保留一種美德，你選哪個？
prompt.en: Your friend group can keep only one virtue. Which do you choose?

prompt.zh: 如果今天必須少一種社交能力，你寧可失去哪個？
prompt.en: If you had to lose one social skill today, which would you rather lose?

prompt.zh: 如果今晚突然多出 3 小時，你會拿去做什麼？
prompt.en: If you suddenly had 3 extra hours tonight, what would you do?

prompt.zh: 聚會突然冷場，你會怎麼救場？
prompt.en: A hangout suddenly gets awkwardly quiet. How do you save it?

prompt.zh: 公司新增一個福利，你選哪個？
prompt.en: Your company offers one new perk. Which do you pick?

prompt.zh: 明天早上有會議，今晚你最想獲得哪個祝福？
prompt.en: There is a meeting tomorrow morning. Pick one blessing for tonight.

prompt.zh: 你可以刪掉一個日常煩躁來源。
prompt.en: You can delete one everyday annoyance.

prompt.zh: 你們開了一間深夜小店，招牌會是什麼？
prompt.en: Your group opens a late-night shop. What is the specialty?

prompt.zh: 旅行時突然下大雨，接下來怎麼辦？
prompt.en: It suddenly pours during a trip. What now?

prompt.zh: 你得到一位私人助理，但他只會做一件事。
prompt.en: You get a personal assistant, but they only do one thing.

prompt.zh: 朋友生日快到了，你會準備什麼？
prompt.en: A friend's birthday is coming up. What do you prepare?

prompt.zh: 週末只剩半天，你想怎麼用？
prompt.en: You only have half a day left this weekend. How do you use it?

prompt.zh: 你可以讓一種東西永遠免費。
prompt.en: You can make one thing free forever.

prompt.zh: 今晚需要一份快速宵夜，你會做什麼？
prompt.en: You need a quick midnight snack tonight. What do you make?

prompt.zh: 朋友遲到 40 分鐘，你最可能怎麼做？
prompt.en: A friend is 40 minutes late. What are you most likely to do?

prompt.zh: 如果要辦一個主題派對，你會選哪個？
prompt.en: If you had to choose a party theme, what would it be?

prompt.zh: 你可以擁有一個小小超能力。
prompt.en: You can have one tiny superpower.

prompt.zh: 三天假期只能去一個地方。
prompt.en: You get a three-day break, but only one destination.

prompt.zh: 你的朋友群需要一個吉祥物。
prompt.en: Your group needs a mascot.

prompt.zh: 大家今天都很累，晚餐你會提議什麼？
prompt.en: Everyone is tired today. What dinner do you suggest?

prompt.zh: 你可以自動化一件家事。
prompt.en: You can automate one chore.

prompt.zh: 如果要拍一支短影片，你會拍什麼？
prompt.en: If you had to make a short video, what would it be about?

prompt.zh: 如果這個房間要選一個人當末日隊長，隊長最需要哪種能力？
prompt.en: If this room had to choose an apocalypse captain, what skill matters most?

prompt.zh: 如果有一個 App 會誠實評價你的人生狀態，你最怕它顯示什麼？
prompt.en: If an app honestly rated your life status, what result would scare you most?

options.zh: 你比想像中還在意別人
options.en: You care more than you admit

prompt.zh: 如果今晚每個人都要公開一個小缺點，哪種最容易被原諒？
prompt.en: If everyone had to reveal one small flaw tonight, which is easiest to forgive?

prompt.zh: 如果朋友群要立一條新憲法，第一條應該是什麼？
prompt.en: If your friend group wrote a constitution, what should Article One be?

options.en: Arguments must be resolved the same day

prompt.zh: 如果你的個性要被做成商品，最像哪一種？
prompt.en: If your personality became a product, what would it be?

prompt.zh: 如果明天開始大家都能看到你的情緒字幕，你最想隱藏哪一種？
prompt.en: If everyone could see your emotion subtitles tomorrow, which would you hide?

options.en: I actually do not want to go out
I am secretly thinking about dinner

prompt.zh: 如果聚會中突然要選一個人代表大家發言，最重要的是什麼？
prompt.en: If one person had to speak for the whole group, what matters most?

prompt.zh: 如果你可以把一種社交尷尬永久刪除，你選哪個？
prompt.en: If you could delete one social awkwardness forever, which would you choose?

options.en: Two people dodging the same way

prompt.zh: 如果你的朋友群要被拍成影集，第一集最適合叫什麼？
prompt.en: If your friend group became a series, what should Episode One be called?

options.en: Do We Actually Have a Plan?

prompt.zh: 如果今晚的聊天會被變成一種天氣，最像哪個？
prompt.en: If tonight's conversation became weather, what would it be?

prompt.zh: 如果可以偷看大家對你的第一印象，你最想知道哪一項？
prompt.en: If you could see everyone's first impression of you, what would you want to know?

options.en: Whether I seem easy to get along with
Whether I seem like I would be late

prompt.zh: 如果每個人都有一個隱藏稱號，你最想要哪種？
prompt.en: If everyone had a hidden title, which one would you want?
